主要内容: On March 15, 2018, Lawrence S. Bacow, Ph.D., announced his intent not to seek re-election to Henry Schein, Inc.'s board of directors due to his new role as President of Harvard University. He will remain a director and member of the Strategic Advisory Committee and Nominating and Governance Committee until the Annual Meeting. Donald J. Kabat will retire following the Annual Meeting, as per the retirement policy requiring retirement at age 80. The Board extended his retirement date by one year prior to his 2017 reelection. He will remain as a director and Chairperson of the Audit Committee until the Annual Meeting. The Nominating & Governance Committee recommended the director nominee for the Annual Meeting. The Board approved Shira Goodman as a new director nominee. Ms. Goodman previously served as CEO of Staples, Inc. from 2016 to January 2018. The Board also intends to appoint Kurt P. Kuehn as Chairperson of the Audit Committee following Mr. Kabat's retirement. The report was signed on March 19, 2018, by Walter Siegel, Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Henry Schein, Inc.
